title: PrivBayes: Private Data Release via Bayesian Networks
authors: Jun Zhang, Graham Cormode, Cecilia M. Procopiuc, Divesh Srivastava, Xiaokui Xiao
description: PrivBayes releases differentially private synthetic datasets by learning a low-degree Bayesian network over a sensitive database and sampling tuples from noisy conditional distributions, circumventing the curse of dimensionality that defeats earlier approaches.
